name: Reasoning Arena: Chess
description: Objective reasoning benchmark testing spatial reasoning, tactical calculation, and strict rule adherence using verified chess positions, puzzles, and move quality metrics.
attribution: Sourced and verified using python-chess. Tactical themes inspired by open lichess.org puzzle taxonomy (CC0).

default_config.system_prompt: You are a chess reasoning system. Analyze the position and provide your chosen move.

metric_notes.legal_move_rate: Baseline reasoning floor: proportion of attempted moves that obey the official FIDE chess rules.
metric_notes.format_compliance_rate: Proportion of responses containing clean, parseable SAN or UCI moves.
metric_notes.puzzle_accuracy: Accuracy on objective tactical puzzle solutions.
metric_notes.mate_found_rate: Ability to recognize and execute immediate or forced checkmates.
metric_notes.avg_centipawn_loss: Stockfish evaluation loss relative to the optimal move (unavailable if Stockfish is not installed).
metric_notes.blunder_rate: Proportion of moves losing >300 centipawns compared to engine evaluation.
metric_notes.latency: Move calculation and generation response time.
